title: Prompt regression triage scratchpad — Rhea
content:
Personal scratchpad for 1:1 / quick sync: Optimize / Evals prompt regression triage

Meeting context and goal:
- Quick triage of newly observed quality regressions from the latest A/B (variant B) across the retail-assistant prompt set.
- Decide whether to pause rollout, quick fixes, or schedule deeper investigation.
- Capture immediate follow-ups and owners.

Meeting date: 2026-03-12 (prep notes 2026-03-10 to 03-12)
Attendees (planned): Maya, Luis, Jonah, Rhea (me) — invite already sent

Agenda (20–30m):
1) TL;DR A/B result snapshot (5m)
   - Variant B shows ~6% drop in helpfulness score on curated prompt set (n=450) vs control.
   - Hallucination flag rate up from 3.2% -> 6.9% on product SKU facts.
   - P95 generation latency unchanged. Cost delta negligible.
2) Quick examples (5m) — share 3 failure cases (see example snippets below)
3) Hypotheses & immediate checks (7m)
   - prompt-tokenization drift? (different preprocessing in new infra?)
   - decoding/config change (temp/top-k/penalties) applied to variant?
   - model variant: quantized weights or different padding behavior?
   - data/regression from prompt rewrite (recent PR that changed anchoring phrasing)
4) Decide immediate action (3m)
   - rollback, patch prompt set, or gated rollout?
5) Assign follow-ups and timelines (rest)

Quick A/B numbers (from dashboard snapshot):
- eval suite: retail-assistant-ctl-2026-03 (450 prompts)
- control (A): helpfulness 0.78, hallucination rate 3.2%
- variant (B): helpfulness 0.73, hallucination rate 6.9%
- delta helpfulness: -0.05 absolute (~6.4% relative)
- median tokens per response: 42 -> 44 (tiny)
- P95 latency: 210ms -> 215ms (noise)

Three representative failure cases to show (paste into meeting chat):
- Case 1: user asks "Is the XS size available in blue?" B returns "We have blue in medium only" but catalog shows blue/XS in last-sync snapshot. (hallucination: contradicted by DB)
- Case 2: product-spec question returns a made-up dimension "23.7cm" when spec lists 24.1cm. (precision regression)
- Case 3: user asks for recommended pairings; B omits critical allergy warning that control included. (safety/regression)

Immediate checks to run during/after meeting (fast, <1 hour):
- Re-run failing prompts against both control and variant locally (repro-runner) with identical seeds and temp settings to rule out sampling noise (Luis).
- Confirm that inference config in rollout pipeline did not change decoding parameters (Maya).
- Check model binary/quantization flag in build artifact for the variant tag (RED-4231) — possible accidental quantized model (Jonah).
- Verify tokenizer versions/hygiene — tokenization mismatch can change anchoring (Rhea).

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Decoding/config change applied to B (most likely) — quick to verify and revert.
2) Prompt template rewrite accidentally removed anchoring phrase (likely if rollout included prompt changes).
3) Quantization/weight conversion introduced small distribution shift (less likely but high cost to revert).

Risk & rollback criteria (proposal):
- If helpfulness delta > 4% absolute or hallucination rate doubles, pause rollout for region.
- If we can reproduce >75% of failure examples locally with same config, block further rollouts.

Proposed short-term mitigation options:
- Hotfix: revert prompt template changes for retail-assistant channel and re-run A/B (low-risk).
- Patch: add explicit anchoring sentence in prompt ("Refer to product catalog data; do not invent attributes.") and test.
- Rollback: revert to previous model variant if quantization confirmed.

Follow-ups / Action items (recorded here to copy to Jira ticket RED-4231 or create follow-ups):
- Luis: run repro-runner batch on the 50 failing prompts and upload raw outputs + seeds to /tmp/evals/troubleshoot-03012 by EOD 2026-03-12. (owner: Luis Ortega; due: 2026-03-12)
- Maya: audit rollout config (decoding params) and post a diff of the last 3 pipeline commits to the thread. (owner: Maya Singh; due: 2026-03-12 noon)
- Jonah: check build artifacts for quantization flag for variant B; if found, note exact artifact hash and flag in Jira. (owner: Jonah Kim; due: 2026-03-12)
- Rhea (me): run tokenizer version check across infra images and add failing prompts to a short prompt-set that will be used for regression gating. (owner: Rhea Patel; due: 2026-03-13)
- All: be ready to convene a 30m follow-up if >2 of immediate checks confirm the same root cause. (target: 2026-03-12 late afternoon)

Notes about prompt-set curation (for gating):
- Short set: 60 prompts — 40 core retail Qs, 20 safety/spec questions. Prioritize reproducible failures.
- Goal: include both anchor-sensitive and factual-check prompts.
- Metric: helpfulness + hallucination flags + manual safety thumb (pass/fail) per prompt.

Experiment plan if config change not found (next week):
- A/B run with decoding params forced to Control values but using Variant model binary (isolates model vs decoding).
- If mismatch persists, run control model with Variant decoding to measure decoding-only effect.
- If quantization suspected, run small-batch 1k prompts with float32 model and compare.

Questions I want to ask in the meeting:
- When exactly did variant B get built and what PRs were included? (build hash + PR list)
- Any last-minute prompt edits included in rollout?
- Are there infra changes in tokenization or preprocessing in the last 7 days?

Scratch TODOs (personal):
- Create quick Confluence note summarizing meeting + paste key examples (Rhea)
- If rollback happens, prepare communication blurb for partner teams (CSE/Oncall)
- Add a short eval in the weekly cadence so this prompt-set gets run before rollouts in future

Helpful links (put in meeting chat):
- Evals prompt catalog: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVALS/Prompt+Set+Catalog
- Jira: RED-4231 (triage ticket)
- Repro-runner PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro-runner/pull/212

End of scratchpad. Will trim and paste top section into meeting invite and RED-4231 as update after the sync.
